name: prompt-snippets
description: Type ;review, ;tests, ;plan and friends in a prompt and they expand to full instructions. Add your own via the extraSnippets option. /snippets lists them.

extraSnippets.title: Extra snippets (JSON)
extraSnippets.description: A JSON object of name -> text, e.g. {"ship":"Run the checks, then commit and push."}. Used as ;name in a prompt.
